headlines.text: It was 2023 when Hook vs. Ethan Page fought tooth and nail for the FTW Title in a FTW Rules match, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.50. This stood as the 10th match in FTW Title history ? a nice marker in that championship's story. In a rematch under FTW Rules, Hook extended his undefeated AEW record to 25-0, retaining his title after a brawl that spilled through the crowd and up the arena stairs.
Looking back to 2021, when it was JD Drake's first night in AEW against Darby Allin, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.28.

Rewind to 2023, when Orange Cassidy vs. Dralistico went to battle over the AEW International Title, appearing on Battle of the Belts, rated 6.41. It was the first title opportunity of Dralistico's career. A hard-fought battle for the gold.

secondaries.text: Flash back to 2023, when Billie Starkz touched down in AEW for the first time against Jade Cargill, appearing on Battle of the Belts, rated 5.14.

Rewind to 2023, when the ROH World Tag Team Titles was up for grabs as The Lucha Brothers vs. Hobbs & Marshall went to war, appearing on Battle of the Belts, rated 6.57. It was the first title opportunity of Hobbs & Marshall's career.
Back on this day in 2023, Anna Jay AS was back in action after just under 3 months away, appearing on Rampage.
